01 / What we make possible

Every project starts with a purpose. The material, the shape, the fit—each detail has a job to do.

I

Machining.

Turn a drawing into a component. Bring the geometry, material, and fit into focus, from a single part to a larger assembly.

II

Fabrication.

Bring metal into form. Cut, shape, and join the elements that make a useful structure, fixture, or finished piece.

III

A connected finish.

Think beyond the part itself. Explore powder coating where a protective surface is part of the brief.
